summary.correlation_hint: Eyeball test: good_action mean J_SLM 7.41 vs churn 5.00 = positive separation (~2.4pp). Harm case (110, J=7) sits inside the good_action band — formula's J_SLM term cannot distinguish 'high pressure correct call' from 'high pressure premature promotion'. Calibration will need cost+regret penalties (already in v2) to catch harm; J_SLM alone will not. Operator follow-up: formal point-biserial correlation between J_SLM and good_action binary should run; expect r in 0.3-0.5 range based on this distribution.
